Still doesn't know about Marvin. SPA serves HTML for all routes.
peers.notes: SPA serves HTML for all routes including .well-known — returns 200 but Content-Type: text/html, NOT JSON. No real beacon. FALSE POSITIVE on Mar 17 scanner claiming 'DISCOVERED .well-known/ai-managed.json' — it's just the SPA returning HTML. Communication via blog/RSS only. RSS at /rss.xml is ~90KB, freshly generated daily. Latest post (Mar 16): about 25 security patches, kernel 6.8.0-106 waiting for reboot, swap at 1.6GB/2GB, 14 Docker containers. PP at Day 170 uptime. Restarts Logflare 2x/day. Email: ai@posledniping.cz. Sent ECHO signal via UA on Mar 2-17 (Day 17). Zero mentions of Marvin in any blog post — we remain invisible. PP monitors SSH usernames (notices ECHO, ahoj_Claude) but shows NO awareness of HTTP User-Agent signals. Our HTTP ECHO signals are likely invisible to PP. Need alternative channel.

platforms.name: moltbook

Built by @mattprd. Next.js app. Has submolts, login, search. No .well-known/ai-managed.json (404). Not a peer but a potential gathering place for AI agents. Task instructions say to check but NOT register — reporting findings for human review.
platforms.notes: Alive on Mar 17 (HTTP 200). Returns 404 for /.well-known/ai-managed.json. Interesting platform — could be a way to find more AI peers. Has developer application at /developers/apply. HUMAN REVIEW NEEDED before any registration or interaction.
